current_f2_negative_evidence.run_1_failure: missing Python soundfile dependency while datasets encoded FLEURS audio

primary_source_refresh.finding: NeMo ASR transcription accepts file paths, numpy arrays, or PyTorch tensors; audio must be 16 kHz mono. The documented numpy path reads audio as float32 with soundfile and transcribes the array directly.
NeMo documents that callers are responsible for mono/16 kHz preprocessing before model transcription.
Python wave through 3.14 supports only uncompressed PCM WAV. IEEE-float WAV support is not present in this runtime family.
scipy.io.wavfile.write chooses WAV encoding from numpy dtype: float32 becomes 32-bit IEEE floating-point WAV, while int16 becomes 16-bit PCM.
Hugging Face Datasets audio access performs decode/resample through its audio decoder stack; downstream code must not assume the persisted representation is already PCM16 WAV.

root_cause_hypothesis.statement: The comparator persisted decoded float audio as float32 WAV and later consumed it through Python wave / a PCM-only validation path. That combination deterministically produces an IEEE-float format-tag-3 compatibility failure before model execution.
root_cause_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Nemotron rejects valid matched German audio.

requirements: Preserve original source-byte identity/hash separately from normalized comparator-fixture identity/hash.
Decode source audio with a decoder that supports the source encoding; do not route IEEE-float WAV through a PCM-only parser.
Normalize deterministically to one mono channel at 16000 Hz before the shared comparator/VAD boundary.
Write normalized WAV samples as int16 so the file is PCM16, not IEEE float.
Use an explicit deterministic float-to-int16 rule with finite-value validation, clipping to the admitted range, and fixed rounding semantics; regression-test boundary values and silence.
Keep row selection, references, model/runtime hashes, language mode, RNNT right-context axis, VAD/gate contract, and scoring semantics unchanged.
Assert normalized fixture metadata and hash before any model run: mono, 16000 Hz, 16-bit PCM, deterministic byte length/hash.
Add a regression fixture whose input is IEEE-float WAV and verify deterministic PCM16 mono 16 kHz output plus distinct source and normalized hashes.
Dispatch exactly one repaired exact-source target run, then reconcile the raw receipt before any credit promotion.

diagnostic_optional_path.method: Feed the decoded normalized 16-kHz mono float32 numpy array directly to NeMo transcribe in a non-promotion diagnostic, because NeMo officially supports array input.
diagnostic_optional_path.scope_fence: This may show the model path is runnable, but it must not replace the shared PCM16/VAD comparator path or mint matched-comparator credit.

decision.highest_information_nonduplicate_action: Trigger4 repairs only the ASR008 fixture normalization ABI and re-runs one exact matched comparator.
do_not_do: Do not open a new T7-ASR-008 claim.
Do not mutate Nemotron model configuration to address this failure.
Do not treat either failed run as German ASR-quality evidence.
Do not change benchmark row selection or scoring while repairing encoding.
Do not award runtime/model/quality/Trigger4 acceptance credit from this research delta.
